## Executive Summary

- **#1 (MODERATE, tool, ~3h)**: Cline #12675 prevents debounced input from
  firing onChange on mount. `useDebouncedInput` scheduled its debounced
  onChange on mount and on every external initialValue resync, not just user
  edits. Settings fields mount with placeholder values while provider config
  loads asynchronously, so the mount-fire echoed placeholders ~100ms later.
  DebouncedTextField-backed secret fields (e.g. OpenRouter API key) lost
  that race and wrote `apiKey: ""`, silently deleting stored keys from both
  providers.json and legacy secrets store. Now gates the debounced save on
  actual user edits: only values set through the returned setter fire
  onChange; mount and external resyncs never do. Alexi has Ink-based TUI
  forms (ink-text-input, ink-select-input). Applicable if Alexi has debounced
  inputs that could fire on mount and overwrite persisted config. Size:
  MODERATE (~3h: audit TUI input components for mount-fire, add edit-gating
  to debounced handlers, test mount/resync scenarios).
- **#2 (MODERATE, provider, ~4h)**: Cline #12628 preserves custom model
  metadata across model-id changes. Changing OpenAI Compatible model id
  committed the new id without overrides, so an id unknown to the catalog
  resolved to safe defaults (inputPrice/outputPrice 0, supportsPromptCache
  false) and paid requests billed as $0.0000. Legacy extension kept user-
  authored metadata in a single id-independent blob, so custom prices
  survived id edits. Now recommits the currently displayed overrides under
  the new id when the model id changes, and lets edits made while that commit
  is round-tripping target the pending id instead of the stale read-back id.
  Per-mode pending-override accumulators prevent mode-switch state loss.
  Alexi supports OpenAI-compatible provider (`src/providers/index.ts`) and
  custom model overrides (routing-config.json, model catalog). Applicable if
  Alexi allows runtime model-id changes with custom pricing/context/
  capabilities. Size: MODERATE (~4h: add pending-override accumulator, recommit
  overrides on id change, scope pending state per mode if applicable, cover
  deferred-commit scenarios).
- **#3 (MODERATE, core, ~3h)**: Cline #12626 migrates legacy API keys for
  all secret-backed providers. `collectCandidateProviderIds` only nominated 11
  provider ids while `buildLegacyProviderSettings` can copy keys for 34, so
  stored keys for the other 25 providers (deepseek, mistral, xai, groq, ...)
  were silently dropped during migration unless the provider was the active
  plan/act provider. Now adds the missing candidate checks so any stored key
  makes its provider a migration candidate. Also picks the legacy mode per
  candidate (split plan/act config applied single globalState.mode to every
  provider, replacing non-current mode's configured model with catalog
  default). Migration re-runs on manager construction and never overwrites
  existing entries, so users who already ran the buggy migration get dropped
  keys backfilled. Alexi has no multi-mode (plan/act) system or VS Code
  globalState migration. Pattern is generic: incomplete migration candidate
  enumeration silently drops stored config. Size: MODERATE (~3h: audit config
  migration logic if present, ensure all config sources are candidate-
  enumerated, add migration re-run on construction if applicable).
- **#4 (MODERATE, tool, ~2h)**: Cline #12621 stops Ollama model picker from
  polling /api/tags once per second forever. Ollama provider form polled
  /api/tags every 2s from two places at once (OllamaProvider and a dead
  duplicate poll in ApiOptions), producing ~1 req/s for as long as the
  settings pane was open. Since base URL is user-configurable, this could
  hammer a remote or metered endpoint. VSCodeLmProvider and LMStudioProvider
  had the same interval pattern. Now removes all useInterval model polling;
  fetches on mount and when base URL changes instead. Adds refresh on picker
  field focus so a server started after pane opened is still discovered.
  Alexi has no Ollama/LM Studio provider integration yet. Applicable if Alexi
  adds local model provider support (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) with model
  enumeration endpoints. Size: MODERATE (~2h: avoid setInterval for model
  enumeration, fetch on mount/URL change/focus instead, ensure no unbounded
  polling).

## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Debounced input mount-fire prevention (tool, ~3h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #12675 prevents debounced input from firing onChange on
  mount. `useDebouncedInput` scheduled its debounced onChange on mount and on
  every external initialValue resync, not just user edits. Settings fields
  mount with a placeholder value while their backing provider config is still
  loading asynchronously, so the mount-fire echoed that placeholder back to
  the backend ~100ms later. For DebouncedTextField-backed secret fields (e.g.
  the OpenRouter API key, which renders a masked value derived from the async
  readProviderConfig response), losing that race meant writing `apiKey: ""`
  — silently deleting the stored key from both providers.json and the legacy
  secrets store, and leaving the field rendering empty despite a previously
  persisted key. Non-secret fields similarly re-saved stale placeholder
  values on every mount. Now gates the debounced save on an actual user edit:
  only values set through the returned setter fire onChange; mount and
  external resyncs never do.
- **Why**: Alexi has Ink-based TUI forms (ink-text-input v6.0.0, ink-select-
  input v6.2.0). Applicable if Alexi has debounced inputs that could fire on
  mount and overwrite persisted config (API keys, model configs, routing
  settings). The pattern is generic: debounced handlers that fire on mount/
  resync instead of user edits can race with async config loads and silently
  delete stored values. Size: MODERATE (~3h: audit TUI input components for
  mount-fire onChange, add edit-gating to debounced handlers if present, test
  mount/resync scenarios, ensure config load completes before render).
  Portable (TypeScript, React hooks, Ink components).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12675 "Fix useDebouncedInput firing onChange on
  mount, which could wipe stored API keys" (merged 2026-07-29T05:39:13Z,
  commit `159961b`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/
  12675.
- **Category**: tool. **Size**: MODERATE (~3h: audit TUI input components,
  add edit-gating to debounced handlers, test mount/resync scenarios).
  **Status**: MODERATE signal (debounced input mount-fire is a generic race
  condition; Alexi has Ink-based TUI forms; applicable if debounced inputs
  exist).

#### 2. Custom model metadata preservation across id changes (provider, ~4h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #12628 preserves custom model metadata across model-id
  changes. Changing the OpenAI Compatible model id committed the new id
  without overrides, so an id unknown to the catalog resolved to safe
  defaults (inputPrice/outputPrice 0, supportsPromptCache false) and paid
  requests billed as $0.0000. The legacy extension kept this user-authored
  metadata in a single id-independent blob, so custom prices survived id
  edits. Now recommits the currently displayed overrides under the new id
  when the model id changes, and lets edits made while that commit is round-
  tripping target the pending id instead of the stale read-back id. Includes
  per-mode pending-override accumulators (separate for Plan and Act) to
  prevent mode-switch state loss, and a deferred-commit mode-switch test.
- **Why**: Alexi supports OpenAI-compatible provider (`src/providers/index.ts`)
  and custom model overrides (routing-config.json, model catalog). Applicable
  if Alexi allows runtime model-id changes with custom pricing/context/
  capabilities. The pattern is generic: changing a primary key (model id)
  without carrying forward secondary metadata (pricing, context, cache
  support) silently drops user config. Size: MODERATE (~4h: add pending-
  override accumulator to model config state, recommit displayed overrides
  under new id on id change, scope pending state per mode if applicable,
  cover deferred-commit scenarios with tests, handle round-trip races).
  Portable (TypeScript, state management, provider metadata).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12628 "fix(openai-compatible): carry custom model
  metadata across model-id changes (ENG-2341)" (merged 2026-07-29T05:30:19Z,
  commit `4a3f1ce`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/
  12628. Fixes ENG-2341.
- **Category**: provider. **Size**: MODERATE (~4h: add pending-override
  accumulator, recommit overrides on id change, scope pending state per mode,
  cover deferred-commit scenarios). **Status**: MODERATE signal (custom model
  metadata preservation is a UX/billing correctness issue; Alexi supports
  OpenAI-compatible provider and custom model overrides; applicable if
  runtime model-id changes are allowed).

#### 3. Complete legacy API key migration (core, ~3h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #12626 migrates legacy API keys for all secret-backed
  providers. `collectCandidateProviderIds` only nominated 11 provider ids
  while `buildLegacyProviderSettings` can copy keys for 34, so stored keys
  for the other 25 providers (deepseek, mistral, xai, groq, ...) were
  silently dropped during migration unless the provider was the active plan/
  act provider. Now adds the missing candidate checks so any stored key makes
  its provider a migration candidate. Also picks the legacy mode per
  candidate: a split plan/act config applied the single globalState.mode to
  every provider, so the non-current mode's configured model was replaced by
  the catalog default. Includes alias normalization during migration (togetherai
  -> together, sap-ai-core -> sapaicore) to avoid duplicate alias/canonical
  entries. Migration re-runs on manager construction and never overwrites
  existing entries, so users who already ran the buggy migration get dropped
  keys backfilled from the still-present legacy secrets.json on next launch.
- **Why**: Alexi has no multi-mode (plan/act) system or VS Code globalState
  migration. However, the pattern is generic: incomplete migration candidate
  enumeration silently drops stored config. Applicable if Alexi has or will
  add config migration logic (e.g., migrating from routing-config.json v1 to
  v2, or from legacy environment variables to a unified config file). Size:
  MODERATE (~3h: audit config migration logic if present, ensure all config
  sources are candidate-enumerated, normalize alias forms, add migration
  re-run on construction if applicable, never overwrite existing entries).
  Portable (TypeScript, config migration, provider metadata).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12626 "fix(core): migrate legacy API keys for all
  secret-backed providers (ENG-2337)" (merged 2026-07-29T04:59:39Z, commit
  `daa32ee`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/12626.
  Fixes ENG-2337.
- **Category**: core. **Size**: MODERATE (~3h: audit config migration logic,
  ensure all config sources are candidate-enumerated, add migration re-run on
  construction). **Status**: MODERATE signal (incomplete migration candidate
  enumeration is a generic config-loss issue; Alexi has no current migration
  logic but may need it for future config schema changes).

#### 4. Stop Ollama model picker unbounded polling (tool, ~2h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #12621 stops Ollama model picker from polling /api/tags
  once per second forever. The Ollama provider form polled /api/tags every 2s
  from two places at once (OllamaProvider and a dead duplicate poll in
  ApiOptions whose result was never read), producing ~1 req/s for as long as
  the settings pane was open. Since the base URL is user-configurable, this
  could hammer a remote or metered endpoint. VSCodeLmProvider and
  LMStudioProvider had the same interval pattern. Now removes all useInterval
  model polling; fetches on mount and when the base URL changes instead.
  Refreshes the Ollama model list when the picker field gains focus so a
  server started after the pane opened is still discovered. LM Studio and VS
  Code LM: refetch models when the model dropdown or manual model id field
  gains focus; VS Code LM adds an explicit 'Refresh the model list' link to
  the empty state.
- **Why**: Alexi has no Ollama/LM Studio provider integration yet (src/
  providers/ shows sapOrchestration, deepseek, auth, connectivity, format,
  model-match, transform, sessionHeaders, adaptiveThinking, ca). Applicable
  if Alexi adds local model provider support (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) with
  model enumeration endpoints. The antipattern is generic: unbounded polling
  (useInterval, setInterval) for model enumeration instead of event-driven
  fetches (mount, URL change, user focus/refresh). Size: MODERATE (~2h: avoid
  setInterval for model enumeration, fetch on mount/URL change/focus instead,
  add explicit refresh affordance if needed, ensure no unbounded polling).
  Portable (TypeScript, React hooks, REST API fetching).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12621 "fix: stop Ollama model picker polling /api/
  tags once per second forever (ENG-2344)" (merged 2026-07-28T23:44:46Z,
  commit `255be9a`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/
  12621. Fixes ENG-2344.
- **Category**: tool. **Size**: MODERATE (~2h: avoid setInterval for model
  enumeration, fetch on mount/URL change/focus instead, ensure no unbounded
  polling). **Status**: MODERATE signal (unbounded polling is a resource
  antipattern; Alexi has no local model provider support yet; applicable if
  Ollama/LM Studio integration is added).
